articles.title: Keyrock acquires BlockFills trading assets to expand institutional crypto business
articles.snippet: The deal adds institutional trading clients, derivatives expertise and regulatory licenses as Keyrock looks to deepen its presence in crypto capital markets.

articles.title: Cantor and Securitize collaborate on blockchain-based IPOs
articles.snippet: The move creates a pathway for public companies to raise capital onchain and issue tokenized securities.

articles.title: The privacy paradox of protecting kids online
articles.snippet: We don’t need to imagine the privacy pitfalls of age verification. They’ve been happening for years, argues Cardano Foundation CEO Frederik Gregaard.

articles.title: Tokenized stocks market cap gains to record $2.3B
articles.snippet: The market capitalization of tokenized stocks rose to a record $2.3 billion, as investors sought exposure to the growing list of tokenized equity products launched by cryptocurrency exchanges.

articles.title: FATF urges faster crypto AML enforcement as stablecoin crime increases
articles.snippet: The global task force said criminal networks are using stablecoins and developing proprietary tokens to evade asset freezes as countries struggle to enforce crypto AML rules.
